rationale: The agent did authenticate the user and accessed the correct account/order, but then executed order-changing writes (return and exchanges) without explicit user confirmation, violating the policy. It also failed to present or compare the savings for both options (return vs. exchanges) as requested; the single calculation shown only covers exchange savings and omits the water bottle return savings. Final information and confirmation were not provided before acting. Therefore, the request was not completed in line with the stated policy.
